metadata.title: मैने बीटीपी क्यों बनाई है । Bhartiya Tribal Party (BTP) Leader Chhotu Bhai Vasava । Main Bhi Bharat
metadata.description:
Chhotu Bhai Vasava is a renowned tribal leader from the state of Gujarat. He is the patron of the Bhartiya Tribal Party. Bhartiya Tribal Party represents the tribal population of India. It has 2 MLAs each in the state of Rajasthan and Gujarat.
Chhotu Bhai Vasava who is also an MLA is leading a movement to implement schedule 5 in the tribal areas of Gujarat and other parts of the country. He says government is targeting Adivasi leaders and activists and branding them as naxal to curb their lawful demands.
Here he speaks to Main Bhi Bharat exclusively.
